note: Every row reproduces byte for byte from the fields beside it. A row with an invariant is aimed: quint is asked to refute 'this label never occurs' and the counterexample is kept. A row with none is an ordinary walk.

goldens.name: walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk. It is where the ordinary labels come from — released, dispatched, task-done, settled and the desk-only revoke — without any of them being asked for.

goldens.name: work-execution-unavailable
goldens.purpose: Infrastructure refuses to run an intact contract. It is not failed work: the set retires as cancelled and the wall names its own reason.

goldens.name: evaluation-blocked
goldens.purpose: The same infrastructure refusal against an evaluation set, which is its own wall: the judgement is intact and unmade, so this is the only park whose resume re-enters evaluation. Its pair is work-execution-unavailable, the same refusal one phase earlier.

goldens.name: evaluation-blocked-resume
goldens.purpose: The blocked wall's own exit, and the only resume that re-asks part of what it interrupted: the stage comes back at the next generation owing the evaluator infrastructure stopped, while the one that answered keeps what it said. Its pair is evaluation-blocked, the park this continues from; the aim is a state and not a label, because every wall's resume carries the same label (mc_chuggy_directed partialEvaluationResumed).

goldens.name: eval-stage-passed
goldens.purpose: The stage advance: a stage passes, the next one spawns, and the ticket stays in Evaluation. It is the only step whose transition is a phase to itself.

goldens.name: finalization-needs-work
goldens.purpose: A finalizer reports failure and the ticket re-enters work. There is no wall on this edge: the finalizer that keeps failing keeps buying cycles.

goldens.name: work-failure-escalated
goldens.purpose: The work wall: the work task resolves Failed and the cycle escalates, parking the ticket at ResumeWork with an open desk task.

goldens.name: rework-started-eval-failure
goldens.purpose: The Rework disposition on a failing evaluation: the stage retires and the ticket re-enters Work with a fresh work task. Its pair is evaluation-failure-escalated, which is the same failure taken the other way.

goldens.name: evaluation-failure-escalated
goldens.purpose: The Escalate disposition on a failing evaluation: the same state as rework-started-eval-failure, parked at the desk instead of reworked.

goldens.name: rework-wall-resume
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-resumed" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or (t.to == Work and tickets.get(t.ticket).evaluations.length() > 0 and match currentInstance(tickets.get(t.ticket)).state { | EvaluationFailed(_) => true | _ => false })))
goldens.purpose: The desk sends an escalated ticket back: the judgement it last reached is a failed one, so this is the evaluation wall's exit, and it re-enters Work with a fresh work task rather than a second opinion on the old artifact.

goldens.name: finalization-succeeded
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-done" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or t.from == Finalization))
goldens.purpose: The finalizer draws FinalizationSucceeded and the ticket completes Finalization -> Done. It is the only completion route this machine has: a passing final stage always runs a finalizer first.

goldens.name: finalization-unavailable
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-resumed" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or t.to == Finalization))
goldens.purpose: The finalizer reaches no result, the ticket parks at ResumeFinalization, and the desk's resume runs the finalizer again. It is aimed at the resume rather than at the wall so one row carries both halves: a resume into Finalization is the only one this machine has, and only this wall stamps it.
